item.title: DOJ says House's top lawyer 'refused to be involved' ahead of Omar search (Kyle Cheney/Politico)
item.description:
Kyle Cheney / Politico:
DOJ says House's top lawyer ‘refused to be involved’ ahead of Omar search  —  Trump administration investigators reached out to the House's top lawyer prior to executing a search warrant at the home of Rep. Ilhan Omar last month, according to newly unsealed court records.

item.title: Democrats announce plans for 12 debates starting in June for 2028 presidential race (Zak Hudak/CBS News)
item.description:
Zak Hudak / CBS News:
Democrats announce plans for 12 debates starting in June for 2028 presidential race  —  The Democratic National Committee on Monday unveiled a primary presidential debate plan that includes 12 debates starting in June 2027 and running through early 2028 as the field narrows from what's now a wide-open race.
